# MOTIFLO

> MOTIFLO is an Indian brand selling a cordless, rechargeable mini mood lamp (about 14 cm tall) with a magnetic, flexible LED filament that changes shape when you shake it. Warm 2700K light, touch modes (soft, bright, breathing, off), USB-C charging. Sold gift-boxed with a 1-year India replacement warranty, on motiflo.in and Amazon.in.
